jobs.prompt:

ONLY CORRECT BODY WIDTH/SILHOUETTE to match the specified originaltype ininput2. Target body was too similar inwidth to normal. Make the width difference unmistakable in ALL4poses. Do not add a head/face/hair/cap. Four headless bodies: frontstanding, rightwardrunning, rightwardbatting, bowing. 1774x887 transparentcanvas. Standing neckx220, runningneckx640, battingneckx1020, bowedneckx1545. Feetaroundy750, preserve same heights as target.
